units.source_text: 首先是，寺庙的生活变得快乐了。

en.t: First of all, life at the temple became pleasant.

units.source_text: 一想到金阁迟早会被烧掉，本来难以忍受的事物也变得容易忍受了。

en.t: When I thought that the Golden Pavilion would sooner or later be burned down, things that had once been unbearable became easier to endure.

units.source_text: 像是预感到死亡的人似的，我对待寺庙的人的态度变得和蔼可亲，

en.t: Like a person who has sensed his own death approaching, my attitude toward the people at the temple became gentle and friendly,

units.source_text: 待人接物变得明朗大度，办任何事也变得以和为贵。

en.t: my dealings with others became bright and generous, and in everything I came to value harmony above all.

units.source_text: 甚至对大自然也采取和解的态度。

en.t: I even adopted an attitude of reconciliation toward nature itself.

units.source_text: 对各天每日早晨飞来啄食残存的落霜红果的小鸟的胸毛也抱有一种亲切感。

en.t: I even felt a certain tenderness toward the breast feathers of the little birds that flew in every morning to peck at the red berries left under the frost.
